tools.name: keycrm_list_orders
tools.description: List orders with filters. For unfulfilled orders, first call keycrm_list_order_statuses, then pass the status id here. Use include=buyer,products.offer,status to get the customer and products in one call. One page per call; keyCRM allows 20 requests per minute per key. GET /order.

tools.name: keycrm_get_order
tools.description: Get one order by id, with its products, buyer, status, payments and shipping when included. GET /order/{id}.

tools.name: keycrm_list_order_statuses
tools.description: List the active order statuses with their ids and names. Call this first to find the status id for unfulfilled or new orders. GET /order/status.

tools.name: keycrm_list_order_sources
tools.description: List order sources (sales channels) with their ids. GET /order/source.

tools.name: keycrm_list_order_tags
tools.description: List order tags with their ids, for keycrm_add_order_tag and keycrm_remove_order_tag. GET /order/tag.

tools.name: keycrm_list_buyers
tools.description: List buyers (customers) with filters by id, phone, email or date. Use include=company,manager,loyalty for related data. GET /buyer.

tools.name: keycrm_get_buyer
tools.description: Get one buyer (customer) by id. GET /buyer/{id}.

tools.name: keycrm_list_products
tools.description: List catalog products with filters by id, category or archive status. Use include=custom_fields for custom fields. GET /products.

tools.name: keycrm_get_product
tools.description: Get one catalog product by id. GET /products/{id}.

tools.name: keycrm_list_offers
tools.description: List product variants (offers) with their ids and SKUs. GET /offers.

tools.name: keycrm_list_stock_levels
tools.description: List stock levels per product variant. Set details=true to get the stock per warehouse. GET /offers/stocks.

tools.name: keycrm_list_pipeline_cards
tools.description: List sales pipeline cards (deals) with filters by pipeline, status, source or date. GET /pipelines/cards.

tools.name: keycrm_list_users
tools.description: List team users (managers) with their ids, roles and status. Match a user id to the manager of an order from keycrm_list_orders with include=manager. GET /users.

tools.name: keycrm_add_order_tag
tools.description: WRITE: add an existing tag to an order. Changes the order in the customer's keyCRM account. Get tag ids from keycrm_list_order_tags. POST /order/{id}/tag/{tag_id}.

tools.name: keycrm_remove_order_tag
tools.description: WRITE: remove a tag from an order in the customer's keyCRM account. The tag itself is kept. DELETE /order/{id}/tag/{tag_id}.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: keycrm_list_buyers, keycrm_add_order_tag · Public sink: keycrm_list_buyers, keycrm_add_order_tag · Destructive: keycrm_remove_order_tag.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: keycrm_list_buyers, keycrm_add_order_tag · Public sink: keycrm_list_buyers, keycrm_add_order_tag · Destructive: keycrm_remove_order_tag

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
